sections.heading: What the Service is
paragraphs: Droblet is a personal wardrobe and style app. With the Service you can:
- build your digital wardrobe by photographing your clothes or entering them by hand (AI suggests type, colour and fabric; you confirm before anything is saved);
- create looks (outfits), plan your calendar and record what you wore;
- get a daily outfit, a weekly plan and a packing list from the stylist;

- see outfits and shop products on your own full-body photo — or, without one, on a figure built from your face photo and the body type you choose (“See it on me”) — and get a colour palette analysis from your face photo;
- explore the weekly edit and the shop catalogue, and be sent to the brand's own shop to buy;
- follow friends, see their closets and looks as far as their visibility setting allows, and rate looks.

Wardrobe, looks, calendar, shop and social features are free. AI features need Droblet Membership; non-members can use AI garment recognition for free on their first 10 item photos. Details are in the Subscription Terms.
We keep developing the Service; features may be added, changed or removed. If we materially reduce a paid feature we will tell you in advance (see section 16).

They are there to give you ideas and can be wrong: they do not guarantee a product's size, fit, colour or how it will look on you. Public accounts are followed at once; for Followers-only or Private accounts a follow request is sent, which the owner approves or declines.
You can rate looks with 1 to 5 stars. The look's owner sees the average and the number of ratings, never who gave them.
You can report a person or their content and block them. You and a person you block cannot see each other anywhere. Details are in the Community Guidelines.

summary: Your full-body photo, your face photo and the images generated on you are visible only to you and are never shown to anyone else in any setting.

sections.heading: The data we process
paragraphs: Information you give us:

- Account: your name, e-mail address and a one-way hash of your password (the password itself is never stored). If you sign in with Apple or Google, the account id, e-mail address (with Apple this may be a private relay address) and name those services provide; with Sign in with Apple, an Apple refresh token stored encrypted so that we can revoke the link with Apple when you delete your account.
- Profile: your username (@handle), display name, language, the city you choose for weather, and your closet visibility setting.
- Style profile: who it is for (currently Women), the three style tags you choose and your budget range.
- Body profile: your height, your size and, optionally, your weight.
- Photos: your full-body photo and your face photo; the item and outfit photos you take or upload for your wardrobe.

- Wardrobe and planning: your items and their details (type, colour, fabric, season, brand, size), your looks, calendar plans, what you wore, your trips (city and dates), the occasions and free-text requests you send to the stylist, and your “Not for me” feedback.
- Social: whom you follow and who follows you, follow requests, the ratings you give, looks you save, people you block, reports you file and the note you add.
- Shopping: your cart, watch list, favourite products, your clicks through to brands and your answers to “Add to your wardrobe?”.
- Your notification preferences, your time zone and any support messages you send us.
Data created while you use the Service:
- Generated data: images generated on you, your colour palette result (season type and shades), processed (background-removed) item images, AI suggestions.
- Membership and credits: your subscription status, store transaction ids, your AI image credit balance and movements. We never receive your card or payment details.
- Device: a device id (created by the app), platform and push notification token.
- Usage events: certain steps in the app (for example sign-up completed, first item added, membership screen viewed). They contain no name, e-mail or free text (see section 9).

- Product analytics (Google Analytics for Firebase, can be switched off): the names of the screens you open (for example “wardrobe” — not their content or ids), certain steps in the app (for example sign-up, “See it on me” started, item added), coarse user properties, Firebase's app instance id, device model, operating system and app version, language and an approximate location (country/city) derived from the IP address. No name, e-mail, free text, photo or item name is sent (see section 9).
- Technical and security data: IP address, request time, error records; sign-in attempt counters to prevent abuse.
Information from others:
- Apple and Google: your sign-in details; App Store and Google Play: purchase, renewal, cancellation and refund notifications.
- Affiliate networks and brands: if you order from a brand you reached through Droblet, the order number, amount, currency and order status (never your name, address or payment details).
- Other users: follow requests sent to you, ratings given to your looks, reports about you.

sections.heading: Photos, your face photo and your weight
paragraphs: Uploading a full-body or face photo is optional; you can use the app without them. If you upload one, its location and device information (EXIF/XMP metadata) is removed in the first processing step, the clean copy is stored encrypted in storage that is closed to the public, and it is shown only to you, through private links that expire quickly.

We use your face photo for two purposes, each with its own explicit consent: the colour palette analysis (the AI looks at the skin, hair and eye colours in the photo and chooses the season type that suits you) and, when you have no full-body photo, “See it on me” (the AI combines your face photo with the body type, height and size you choose to build your figure). We do not identify or verify you or run face recognition; we do not extract or store a template that uniquely identifies you from your face (a biometric template). The AI is explicitly told not to identify, describe or change the person. For these reasons we consider that this is not processing of biometric data; even so, we process your face and full-body photos only with your explicit consent. [LEGAL REVIEW: biometric data assessment, building a figure from the face photo]

We use your full-body photo only to generate “See it on me” images. Because the photo may show your body, it is never shown to other users or to our support or moderation staff under any setting, and it never enters a shared cache.

Your weight is optional and, because it may be seen as close to health data, is stored only with your explicit consent. Height and weight are not sent to the AI provider; the AI is told never to comment on your body, weight or health.
We do not infer special category information such as ethnic origin, health or religion from your photos or any other data.

sections.heading: Why we use your data and our lawful basis
paragraphs: - Opening your account, signing you in, sending password reset e-mails and providing the Service (wardrobe, looks, calendar, trips, shop, social features): performance of our contract with you (UK GDPR art. 6(1)(b)).

- Generating “See it on me” images from your full-body photo or, without one, from your face photo and body type, analysing your colour palette from your face photo and storing your weight: your explicit consent (art. 6(1)(a) and, where needed, art. 9(2)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time.
- Suggesting type, colour and fabric from item photos with AI and removing backgrounds; preparing stylist, weekly plan and packing suggestions: performance of the contract.
- Finding friends from contacts: your consent; for the people in your contacts, legitimate interests (art. 6(1)(f)), because their data never leaves your device in readable form and is not stored.
- Showing your profile card in search and your closet to other users according to your visibility setting: performance of the contract (you choose the setting).
- Verifying membership and credit purchases and managing your membership and credits: performance of the contract; legal obligation for keeping records (art. 6(1)(c)).
- Service notifications such as follow requests and friend ratings: performance of the contract; you can switch them off in settings.
- Notifications of a marketing nature such as the weekly edit and price drops: your consent (see section 16).

- Matching your click to a brand with the order that follows (commission, offering to add what you bought to your wardrobe, adding to your watch list after 48 hours): our legitimate interest in sustaining the Service's revenue model and making shopping easier for you; adding to your wardrobe needs your confirmation.
- Improving and measuring the product with usage events: legitimate interests (with pseudonymous, limited data).

- Product analytics with Google Analytics for Firebase (measuring which features are used and where people get stuck, improving flows): legitimate interests (art. 6(1)(f)). It is on by default; you can switch it off at any time under Settings › Privacy › “Product analytics”, after which that device sends no analytics data to Google. [LEGAL REVIEW: legitimate interests for product analytics and PECR reg. 6 — the statistical/analytics exception introduced by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025; KVKK art. 5/2-f]
- Security, preventing fraud and abuse, rate limits, reviewing reports and moderation: legitimate interests and, where applicable, legal obligation.
- Establishing, exercising or defending legal claims and responding to authorities: legal obligation and legitimate interests.
Where we rely on legitimate interests we have balanced them against your rights and freedoms; you can ask for this assessment and object to the processing.

sections.heading: AI processing
paragraphs: Our AI features are provided by OpenAI (OpenAI, L.L.C. / OpenAI Ireland Ltd [LEGAL REVIEW: contracting entity]). AI calls are made only from our servers; the app never connects to OpenAI directly. What each feature sends:
- Item recognition and background removal: the item or outfit photo with its metadata removed.
- “See it on me”: your full-body photo and the images of the selected pieces.
- Colour palette, and “See it on me” without a full-body photo: your face photo (for the latter together with the body type, height and size you choose).

- Stylist, weekly plan, packing: date, season, occasion, weather, your style profile, your palette result, the type, colour, fabric and season of your wardrobe items, any free text you write, and your language. Your name, e-mail, height and weight are not sent.

OpenAI is a processor acting on our behalf and on our instructions. Under OpenAI's API terms, data sent through the API is not used to train its models; it may be retained for a limited period to monitor for abuse.
AI output is a suggestion only; we make no automated decision with legal or similarly significant effects on you (UK GDPR art. 22). AI suggestions enter your saved data only after you confirm them.

sections.heading: Finding friends from your contacts
paragraphs: This feature is optional. The app first explains what will happen and asks for your agreement; only if you agree does your phone ask for contacts permission.

On your phone, the e-mail addresses in your contacts are turned into SHA-256 hashes with a single-use salt that changes on every request. Only these hashes are sent to us; names, phone numbers and the e-mail addresses themselves never leave your phone.

We compare the hashes with values made the same way from our members' verified e-mail addresses and show you the profile cards of the members found (as far as their visibility settings allow). Uploaded hashes are neither saved nor logged; the salt is deleted after use and expires within 10 minutes at the latest. At most 10 matches can be run per day.

Phone numbers are not used by this feature. You can withdraw the permission at any time in your phone's settings; as no contact data is stored, there is nothing to delete. If you do not want to be found from other people's contacts, the only way at the moment is to delete your account; a separate “don't match me” option may be added later.

sections.heading: Shopping links and commission
paragraphs: When you go to a brand to buy a product we add a click id to the link and record the click with your account, the products and the look, if any. Your name, e-mail or any other identifier is not sent to the brand or to the affiliate network (Admitad, Gelir Ortakları / ReklamAction, or a brand with a direct agreement).

If you place an order, the network or brand tells us the order number, amount, currency and status against that click id. We use this to calculate the commission, to offer to add what you bought to your wardrobe, and to avoid adding a product you bought to your watch list. If no order arrives within 48 hours, the products are added to your watch list with notifications off.

The information you give on the brand's website (name, address, payment) is the brand's responsibility and follows the brand's privacy policy. Cookies used by networks and brands on their own websites are also their responsibility.

sections.heading: Usage events and product analytics
paragraphs: We use no advertising or tracking SDKs and we do not read the advertising identifier (IDFA/AAID). To improve the product, the app sends events from a fixed list (for example “sign-up completed”, “membership screen viewed”, “credit spent”) to our own servers.

When events are stored, a one-way hash replaces your account id; events cannot contain names, e-mail addresses or free text, only short predefined values (for example a screen name, a product id or a number). Because we can recompute this hash from your account, these events are still personal data about you (pseudonymous): they are included in the copy of your data (“Download my data”) and deleted when you delete your account. Otherwise event records are deleted automatically after 400 days.

Product analytics: we also send some of these events and screen views to Google Analytics for Firebase, a service of Google LLC (US); Google acts as our processor for it. What is sent: the event name and short predefined values (for example sign-in method, source, a count, a catalogue product id), the screen name (for example “item/[id]” — never the id itself), coarse user properties (plan type, app language, whether onboarding is finished, whether you have a full-body or face photo, a wardrobe size range), Firebase's app instance id, device, operating system and app version, and an approximate location. The user id is not your account id but the same one-way hash our own analytics uses.

What we do not do: we do not collect the advertising identifier (IDFA/AAID), the Android device id (SSAID) or the iOS identifier for vendors (IDFV); ad storage, ad personalisation signals and registration with ad networks stay off, and Google signals are not enabled. This data is never used for advertising or for tracking you across apps. Names, e-mail addresses, free text, photos, photo links and item names are never sent; the app filters values before sending them.

Switching it off: when you untick Settings › Privacy › “Product analytics”, Firebase Analytics stops on that device at once and your choice is kept. Our own analytics (the events above) is not affected by this setting.

Retention: event-level data is kept in Google Analytics for 14 months and then deleted automatically; reports are aggregated and anonymous. When you delete your account the hash can no longer be matched to your account. [LEGAL REVIEW: the 14-month retention; whether a user deletion request must be sent to Google Analytics when an account is deleted]

sections.heading: What other users can see
paragraphs: - Everyone (in search): your username, display name, style tags, style match percentage, and follower and following counts. Private accounts are visible only to people they have a follow relationship with.

- Depending on your visibility setting (Public: everyone; Followers only: followers you approved; Private: nobody): your processed item images and their names, your looks and your looks' average rating.

- Nobody, in any setting: your full-body and face photos, the images generated on you, your colour palette, your height, weight and size, your calendar and wear log, your trips, cart, watch list, notification settings and e-mail.

- Looks you share to the feed (the “Share to the feed” switch on a look; adult accounts only, off by default): the look's name, occasion, its cover image made of the clothes, the processed images and types of its items, your username and profile picture are shown to all users, whatever your visibility setting. The look leaves the feed the moment you switch it off.
Look images that your friends see are made of item images, never your “See it on me” image. Item images are the background-removed images, not the original photo you took.

To load quickly, background-removed item images (and smaller copies of them) are stored at public web addresses that contain a long random code and cannot be guessed or listed, and are delivered through our content delivery network (Cloudflare). This applies even when your closet is private: anyone who has the exact address of such an image can open it. The cover image of a look you share to the feed (clothes only, no person) is kept at a public address in the same way for as long as it is shared; that copy is deleted when you stop sharing, delete the look or your account, or when the look is taken off the feed. The original photos you take, the cover images of looks you have not shared, your full-body and face photos and the images generated on you are never stored this way; they stay private and are shown only through short-lived private links. When you delete an item or your account, or a moderator removes an item, its public copies are deleted (an address can keep working from a cache for up to one day). [LEGAL REVIEW: public, unguessable addresses for background-removed item images of private closets and for the covers of looks shared to the feed]
Someone who opens your invite link sees only your first name on the web page.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We do not sell your data or share it for advertising. To provide the Service we share it only as far as needed with:
- Amazon Web Services (AWS): servers, database and photo storage; data is stored in the EU, in the Frankfurt region (eu-central-1). Processor.
- OpenAI: AI processing (section 6). Processor.
- Twilio SendGrid: password reset e-mails; your e-mail address and the e-mail content. Processor.
- Cloudflare: delivering and protecting the website; visitors' IP addresses and request details. Processor.
- Apple (Apple Push Notification service) and Google (Firebase Cloud Messaging): delivering notifications to your device; the device's push token and the notification text.

- Google LLC (Google Analytics for Firebase): product analytics (section 9); pseudonymous usage data, app instance id, device details and approximate location. Processor. [LEGAL REVIEW: acceptance of the Google Ads Data Processing Terms and Google Analytics data-sharing settings switched off]
- Apple and Google: Sign in with Apple / Google and App Store / Google Play payments. These companies are separate controllers for their own services.
- Open-Meteo: weather. Our server sends only the coordinates of the city you chose; never your identity or IP address.
- Admitad, Gelir Ortakları (ReklamAction) and brands with direct agreements: only the click id (section 8).
- Other users: as described in section 10.
- Courts, law enforcement and regulators: where the law requires it or to protect someone's vital interests.
- Our legal, accounting and audit advisers; in a merger, transfer or sale of our company, the buyer or successor, who must keep to this policy.
You can ask for the current list of processors at info@alatech.co.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: Droblet is a UK company and our service providers are in several countries. Your data is therefore transferred outside Türkiye and the UK, in particular to the EU (Germany — AWS) and the US (OpenAI, Twilio SendGrid, Google — including Firebase Cloud Messaging and Google Analytics for Firebase —, Apple, Cloudflare).

Transfers from the UK to the EU rely on the UK's adequacy regulations for the EU/EEA. Transfers to the US and other countries rely on appropriate safeguards (for example certified recipients under the UK–US data bridge, the ICO International Data Transfer Agreement, or the UK Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
Transfers from Türkiye abroad are subject to KVKK art. 9; the grounds are set out in the KVKK Information Notice. [LEGAL REVIEW: KVKK standard contracts and notification to the Board]
You can ask for a copy of the transfer safeguards at info@alatech.co.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
paragraphs: - Account, profile, style and body profile, wardrobe, looks, plans, trips, cart, watch list, favourites, follow relationships, the ratings you give, palette result and generated images: until you delete them or your account.
- Full-body and face photos: until you delete or replace them or delete your account.
- Unprocessed uploads (the raw photo before processing): 1 day at most.
- Item drafts awaiting your confirmation and AI job records: 7 days.
- “Not for me” feedback, credit movements and credit reservations: 400 days or until you delete your account, whichever comes first.
- Usage events: 400 days or until you delete your account, whichever comes first (pseudonymous).
- Product analytics (Google Analytics for Firebase): event-level data 14 months, then deleted automatically by Google.
- Password reset link: 30 minutes. Session: access token 60 minutes, refresh token 60 days.
- E-mail verification code and link: 24 hours (only their hashes are stored).
- The copy of your data prepared with “Download my data” (ZIP file): 7 days, then deleted automatically. The record of the request is kept for 30 days.
- Contact-matching salt: 10 minutes at most; uploaded hashes: never stored.
- Notification delivery records: 14 days; store notification records: 90 days.
- Clicks through to brands and order notifications: when you delete your account the link between these records and your account is deleted, and the remaining revenue record is anonymous.
- Reports: when you delete your account, reports about you are deleted and reports you filed remain without your identity.
- Server and security logs: logs never contain e-mail addresses, passwords, photos, the free text you write or AI responses.

- Backups: the live database is protected by 30-day point-in-time recovery; deleted data leaves the backups within 30 days at the latest. Versioning is switched off on photo storage, so no older copy of a deleted photo is kept.
Data we must keep longer because of a legal obligation or an ongoing dispute is kept only for that purpose and only as long as needed.

sections.heading: Deleting photos and deleting your account
paragraphs: Profile › Privacy › “Delete my photos and generated images” deletes your full-body and face photos, every image generated on you and the colour palette result derived from your face photo; pending AI jobs using these photos are cancelled. If you delete only the full-body photo, the images generated with it are deleted too; if you delete only the face photo, the palette result is deleted too. Your wardrobe items are not affected; you can delete them one by one.

You can delete your account in the app (Profile › Settings › Delete my account) or at droblet.alatech.co/delete-account. Deletion covers your account, sign-in identities, profile, all photos and generated images, wardrobe, looks, plans, trips, cart, watch list, device and notification records, follow relationships and follow requests (on both sides), ratings you gave and received, saved looks, blocks, reports about you, your invite code and your entry in the contact-matching directory. If you signed in with Apple, the link with Apple is revoked too.

What remains after deletion: reports you filed (without your identity), anonymous revenue records no longer linked to your account and backups for up to 30 days. Your usage events are deleted with your account.
Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription; you must cancel it separately in the store settings.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the UK GDPR you have the right to:
- access your data and get a copy;
- have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected;
- have your data erased;
- have processing restricted;
- object to processing based on legitimate interests; you can always object to direct marketing;
- receive the data you gave us, processed by automated means on the basis of contract or consent, in a structured, machine-readable format and have it sent to another service (data portability);
- withdraw your consent at any time (this does not affect the lawfulness of processing before the withdrawal);
- not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing that significantly affect you.
If you live in Türkiye, your rights under KVKK art. 11 are explained in the KVKK Information Notice.

Send your request to info@alatech.co from the e-mail address registered to your account. We may ask for more information to confirm your identity. We answer within one month at the latest (for complex requests this may be extended by two further months; we will tell you if so). Requests are free of charge.
You can see, correct and delete most of your data yourself in the app.

You can get a copy of your data yourself in the app: Profile › Settings › Privacy › “Download my data”. The file contains your profile, style and body profile, consents and consent history, wardrobe, looks, plans and wear log, trips, follow relationships, ratings you gave and received, cart and watch list, notifications, purchase, membership and credit history, usage events (pseudonymous) and the images you uploaded or that were generated for you. Records come as machine-readable JSON files and images as their original files, in one ZIP file. The copy is usually ready within a few minutes; a download link then arrives at the e-mail address registered to your account and in Notifications in the app. The link and the file are valid for 7 days. One copy can be prepared at a time and at most one copy can be requested per day. For security, password hashes, session keys, push tokens and internal keys are not included.

If you are not satisfied after contacting us, you can complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO, ico.org.uk) or, in Türkiye, to the Personal Data Protection Board (Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurulu).

sections.heading: Notifications and marketing
paragraphs: Push notifications are sent only if you allow notifications on your phone. You can switch each type on or off in Profile › Settings › Notifications:
- Morning outfit reminder (when you planned a look for that day), follow requests and friend ratings: service notifications.

- Weekly edit and price drops on products in your watch list: these may contain products and offers and can count as marketing; we ask for your separate consent for them. [LEGAL REVIEW: default setting]
We do not currently send marketing e-mails or text messages. If we do, we will ask for your explicit consent first and give you a way to opt out in every message.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Droblet is not for anyone under 18 and we do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If we learn that someone under 18 has opened an account, we delete the account and its data. If you notice this, write to info@alatech.co.
If a version with parental consent for users aged 13 to 18 is offered later, this policy will be updated before then.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We protect your data with: encryption on every connection (TLS); encryption of the database and photo storage; photo storage closed to the public with short-lived private links (the only exceptions: background-removed item images and the covers of looks you share to the feed, at unguessable public addresses — see “What other users can see”); passwords stored with a strong hashing algorithm; each user's data kept under its own key and opened to another user only through the visibility rules; rate limits on sign-in and sensitive actions; role-based, logged administrator access; and an admin panel that never shows users' photos.
No system is completely secure. If a breach affects your data we will tell the competent authority, and you where required, within the legal deadlines.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: Our website's own code sets no cookies, stores nothing in your browser and contains no analytics or advertising tools. The app does not use cookies; while product analytics is on, the Firebase SDK keeps an app instance id on your device (section 9). Details are in the Cookie Notice.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We will tell you about material changes in the app or by e-mail before they take effect; if a new purpose needs your consent, we will ask for it first.
Questions and requests: info@alatech.co · Ala Tech Solutions LTD, Unit 501 Leroy House, 434-436 Essex Road, London N1 3FY, United Kingdom.

kvkk.title: KVKK Information Notice
kvkk.description: Information notice for Droblet users under art. 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) — English courtesy translation.
kvkk.intro: This notice is given under art. 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”) and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform, to inform people who use the Droblet mobile app and the droblet.alatech.co website. This English text is a courtesy translation; the Turkish original prevails. Processing that needs your explicit consent uses separate explicit consent texts; this notice is not a consent statement.
summary: The data controller is Ala Tech Solutions LTD, established in London.
We process account, profile, wardrobe, photo, body, social, shopping, membership and security data to provide the Service.
We rely on your explicit consent for AI processing of your full-body and face photos, your weight, finding friends from contacts and marketing notifications.
Data is stored on AWS servers in Germany and transferred to OpenAI (US) for AI processing.
You can exercise your rights under KVKK art. 11 by applying to info@alatech.co; we answer within 30 days at the latest.

sections.heading: Data controller and representative
paragraphs: Data controller: Ala Tech Solutions LTD, Unit 501 Leroy House, 434-436 Essex Road, London N1 3FY, United Kingdom (company no. 17100391). E-mail: info@alatech.co.

sections.heading: Categories of personal data processed
paragraphs: - Identity: name, username (@handle), display name.
- Contact: e-mail address.
- Visual records: full-body photo, face photo, item and outfit photos, processed item images, images generated on you.
- Physical characteristics and body information: height, size, optional weight; the colour palette result derived from the face photo (season type, shades).

- Customer transactions: style profile (style tags, budget), wardrobe records, looks, calendar and wear log, trips (city, dates), stylist requests and feedback, cart, watch list, favourites, clicks through to brands and order notifications (order no., amount, status), subscription status, store transaction ids, AI credit balance and movements, support correspondence.
- Social interaction: follow relationships and requests, ratings given and received, saved looks, blocks, reports and report notes, closet visibility setting.
- Location: the city you choose for weather (the device location is not read).
- Marketing: notification preferences and consent to marketing notifications.

- Transaction security: password hash, session tokens, Apple/Google account ids, encrypted Apple refresh token, device id, push token, IP address, server logs, sign-in attempt counters, account suspension records.
- Contacts: single-use hashes made on your phone from the e-mail addresses in your contacts (not stored; names, numbers and the addresses themselves never leave your phone).
- Usage events: app events in which a hash replaces the account id and which contain no free text.

- Product analytics: screen views and app events sent to Google Analytics for Firebase, coarse user properties, app instance id, device, operating system and app version, approximate location (a hash replaces the account id; can be switched off in Settings).

Special categories of personal data: We use the face photo for the colour palette analysis and — when there is no full-body photo — to build the “See it on me” figure; we do not identify or verify anyone or run face recognition, and we do not extract or store a biometric template that uniquely identifies a person. We therefore consider that the face photo is not processed as biometric data. Weight may be regarded as health-related data. In both cases we process this data only with your explicit consent. [LEGAL REVIEW: KVKK art. 6 assessment]

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
paragraphs: - Creating your account, authentication and session management, password reset;
- keeping your digital wardrobe, looks, calendar, wear log and trip plans;
- AI item recognition, background removal, and outfit, weekly plan and packing suggestions;

- with your explicit consent, generating “See it on me” images from your full-body photo — or, without one, from your face photo and the body type you choose — and analysing your colour palette from your face photo;
- making suggestions based on the weather;
- providing social features (search, follow, rating, saving, invitations, sharing) according to your visibility setting;
- with your explicit consent, finding friends from your contacts;
- providing the shop catalogue, sending you to brands, tracking affiliate commission, offering to add purchased products to your wardrobe, watch list and price tracking;
- verifying Droblet Membership and extra credit purchases, managing membership and credits;
- sending service notifications and, with your explicit consent, marketing notifications;
- developing and measuring the product (our own usage events and product analytics with Google Analytics for Firebase);
- information and transaction security, preventing abuse and fraud, reviewing reports and enforcing the community guidelines;
- answering requests and complaints and handling data subject applications;
- meeting legal obligations, informing competent authorities and protecting rights in legal disputes.

sections.heading: Legal grounds
paragraphs: - Processing directly related to the formation or performance of a contract (KVKK art. 5/2-c): account, profile, wardrobe, looks, plans, trips, AI item recognition and style suggestions, social features, shop and cart, membership and credits, service notifications, support.
- Compliance with the controller's legal obligation (art. 5/2-ç): requests of competent authorities, data subject applications, keeping required records.
- Establishing, exercising or protecting a right (art. 5/2-e): dispute and complaint processes.

- The controller's legitimate interest, provided it does not harm your fundamental rights and freedoms (art. 5/2-f): security and abuse prevention, moderation, matching affiliate clicks and orders, developing and measuring the product with pseudonymous usage events and Google Analytics for Firebase (can be switched off under Settings › Privacy › “Product analytics”). [LEGAL REVIEW: whether art. 5/2-f suffices for product analytics]

- Explicit consent (art. 5/1 and, where needed, art. 6): AI processing of your full-body and face photos (“See it on me”, colour palette), storing your weight, finding friends from contacts, notifications of a marketing nature and, where needed, incidental transfers abroad. You can withdraw your explicit consent at any time; the related feature then stops working, but you can keep using Droblet's other features.

sections.heading: Method of collection
paragraphs: Your personal data is collected electronically: through the information you enter in the app and on the website, the photos you upload, and automatically while you use the app. Data is also received electronically from Apple and Google (sign-in), the App Store and Google Play (purchase and subscription notifications), affiliate networks and brands (order notifications) and other users (follow requests, ratings, reports).

sections.heading: Transfers of personal data
paragraphs: Within Türkiye: when you go to a brand, only a click id containing neither your name nor your e-mail is shared with the affiliate network Gelir Ortakları (ReklamAction) and with brands that have a direct agreement. Where the law requires it, data may be transferred to competent public authorities and courts.
Abroad: to provide the Service your personal data is transferred to these recipients:
- Ala Tech Solutions LTD (United Kingdom): providing the Service as data controller.
- Amazon Web Services (Germany, Frankfurt): servers, database and photo storage.
- OpenAI (US): AI processing — item and outfit photos, with your explicit consent your full-body and face photos, style profile and wardrobe attributes.
- Twilio SendGrid (US): password reset e-mails — e-mail address.
- Cloudflare (US and global): delivering and protecting the website — IP address.
- Apple and Google (US): sign-in, in-app purchase verification and delivering notifications.
- Google LLC (US) — Google Analytics for Firebase: product analytics — pseudonymous usage data, app instance id, device details and approximate location.
- Admitad (affiliate network abroad [LEGAL REVIEW: country]): the click id only.
- Open-Meteo ([LEGAL REVIEW: country]): only the coordinates of the city you chose; no identity data is transferred.

Transfers abroad are made under KVKK art. 9 with appropriate safeguards (for example standard contracts announced by the Board, signed with the recipients and notified to the Authority in time). For incidental transfers without these safeguards, your explicit consent under art. 9/6-a may be relied on.

sections.heading: Retention periods
paragraphs: Your personal data is kept as long as needed for the purpose: account and content data until you delete it or your account; unprocessed uploads 1 day at most; item drafts and AI job records 7 days; usage events, credit movements and stylist feedback 400 days or until you delete your account, whichever comes first; password reset link 30 minutes; refresh token 60 days. Deleted data leaves backups within 30 days at the latest. The detailed table is in the Privacy Policy.
Product analytics data in Google Analytics for Firebase is kept at event level for 14 months and then deleted automatically.
The e-mail verification code and link are kept for 24 hours, and the copy of your data prepared with “Download my data” for 7 days.
When the period ends, data is deleted, destroyed or anonymised. [LEGAL REVIEW: personal data retention and destruction policy]

sections.heading: Your rights under KVKK art. 11
paragraphs: By applying to the data controller you can:
- learn whether your personal data is processed;
- request information about it if it is;
- learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used for that purpose;
- know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it is transferred;
- request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate;
- request erasure or destruction under the conditions of KVKK art. 7;
- request that correction, erasure and destruction be notified to the third parties to whom the data was transferred;
- object to a result against you arising from analysis of the data exclusively by automated systems;
- claim compensation if you suffer damage because of unlawful processing.

sections.heading: How to apply
paragraphs: In line with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller, you can send your application to info@alatech.co from the e-mail address registered with Droblet, or in writing to Unit 501 Leroy House, 434-436 Essex Road, London N1 3FY, United Kingdom. Your application must include your name, surname, Turkish ID number (if you are a Turkish citizen) or nationality and passport or ID number (if you are not), your address for notifications, your e-mail address if any, and the subject of your request.

We resolve your application free of charge as soon as possible and within 30 days at the latest. If the action involves an additional cost, the fee in the Board's tariff may be charged. If your application is refused, you find the answer insufficient or we do not answer in time, you can complain to the Personal Data Protection Board within 30 days of learning the answer and in any case within 60 days of your application.
You can see, correct and delete most of your data yourself in the app: Profile › Privacy for photos, and Profile › Settings › Delete my account or droblet.alatech.co/delete-account for your account.

You do not need to apply to learn whether your data is processed and to get a copy: Profile › Settings › Privacy › “Download my data” prepares a ZIP file with all your records (JSON) and images, usually within a few minutes; the download link arrives at your registered e-mail address and in Notifications and is valid for 7 days. One copy can be requested per day. This is an addition to the application channels above; you can still apply in writing.

sections.heading: Updates
paragraphs: We update this notice when our processing changes. The current text is always at droblet.alatech.co/kvkk; we announce material changes in the app.

consents.title: Consent Texts
consents.description: The separate consent texts the Droblet app shows: photos and AI (including “See it on me” from the face photo), weight, contacts, marketing notifications, transfers abroad.
consents.intro: The texts below are shown together on one screen when you sign up for the app, each with its own unticked box. Each one is optional and covers only its own subject. If you did not give a consent there, you are asked again when you first use the related feature. This page collects them all so that you can read later what you agreed or did not agree to. General information on how your personal data is processed is in the KVKK Information Notice and the Privacy Policy.
summary: You do not have to consent; if you don't, only the related feature does not work and you can use the rest of Droblet as usual.

Each consent is separate, comes with its own box and covers only its own subject. The “Accept all” button ticks the boxes for you; you can leave any box unticked and tap “Continue with my choices”. [LEGAL REVIEW: “Accept all” button on one screen]
You can withdraw a consent you gave at any time in the app.
We record when you consented and to which version of the text.

sections.heading: How these texts work
paragraphs: The texts are shown on one screen when you sign up, each with its own unticked box; the related feature shows the same text again when needed. You can read each whole text before agreeing. Your consent is specific, informed and freely given within the meaning of KVKK art. 3 and UK GDPR art. 4(11).

When you consent, the date, time, text version and which consent you gave are recorded with your account; the record is kept until you delete your account. [LEGAL REVIEW: retention of consent records]
No consent is a condition for using the features of Droblet that do not depend on it.

sections.heading: Consent 1 — Full-body photo and “See it on me”
paragraphs: Purpose: to generate images that show outfits and shop products on you (“See it on me”).
Data: the full-body photo you upload and the images generated from it. The photo's location and device information is removed in the first processing step after upload.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) to generate the images.
How long: until you delete the photo or the generated images, or your account. The photo and the images are never shown to other users in any setting.
If you do not consent: you cannot use “See it on me”; wardrobe, looks, the stylist and the other features keep working.

Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my full-body photo to generate ‘See it on me’ images, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).”

sections.heading: Consent 2 — Face photo and colour palette analysis
paragraphs: Purpose: to find the colour season and shades that suit you by looking at the skin, hair and eye colours in your face photo (colour palette analysis).

Data: the face photo you upload and the palette result derived from it (season type, shades that suit you and shades to avoid). No identification, verification or face recognition takes place; no face template that uniquely identifies you is extracted or stored.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) for the analysis.
How long: until you delete the photo or your account. When you delete your face photo, the palette result is deleted too. The photo and the palette are never shown to other users in any setting.
If you do not consent: you cannot use the colour palette analysis; the other features keep working.

Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my face photo only for colour palette analysis and without identifying me, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).”

sections.heading: Consent 3 — Weight
paragraphs: Purpose: to complete your body profile. Weight is optional.
Data: the weight you enter. It is not sent to the AI provider and is not shown to other users.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany).
How long: until you remove it or delete your account.
If you do not consent: you leave the weight field empty; no feature is affected.
Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD storing my weight as part of my body profile.”

sections.heading: Consent 4 — Finding friends from your contacts
paragraphs: Purpose: to find people in your contacts who use Droblet.

Data: on your phone, the e-mail addresses in your contacts are turned into SHA-256 hashes with a single-use salt that changes on every request; only these hashes are sent. Names, phone numbers and the e-mail addresses themselves never leave your phone.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the hashes are held in memory on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) only while the match runs.
How long: the hashes are neither saved nor logged; the salt is deleted after use and expires within 10 minutes at the latest.
If you do not consent: your phone never asks for contacts permission; you can find friends by searching for their username or with an invite link.
Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to the e-mail addresses in my contacts being turned into hashes on my phone and sent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD to find my friends on Droblet.”

sections.heading: Consent 5 — Marketing notifications
paragraphs: Purpose: to send notifications that may contain products and offers, such as the weekly edit (looks and products picked by the editor) and price drops on products in your watch list.
Data: your notification preferences, your device's push token, your language and time zone, your watch list.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; notifications are delivered through the Apple Push Notification service on iOS and Google Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android (US).
How long: until you withdraw your consent or delete your account.

If you do not consent: these notifications are not sent. Service notifications such as the morning outfit reminder and follow requests do not depend on this consent and can be switched off one by one.
Consent statement: “I agree to receive notifications that may contain products and offers, such as the weekly edit and price drops.” [LEGAL REVIEW: scope of Turkish Law No. 6563 and the IYS register]

sections.heading: Consent 6 — Transfers abroad
paragraphs: Purpose: transferring your personal data outside Türkiye to provide the Service, because Droblet is established in the UK and its service providers are abroad.

Data and recipients: your account, profile, wardrobe and usage data to Ala Tech Solutions LTD (UK) and AWS (Germany); your photos and wardrobe attributes to OpenAI (US) for AI processing; your e-mail address to Twilio SendGrid (US); your push token to Apple and Google (US).

Basis: these transfers rely first on the appropriate safeguards in KVKK art. 9 (for example standard contracts). This consent is asked under KVKK art. 9/6-a for incidental transfers where those safeguards are not in place. [LEGAL REVIEW: whether this consent is needed and its scope]
How long: until you withdraw your consent or delete your account.
If you do not consent or withdraw: transfers without appropriate safeguards are not made; features that depend on them (for example AI) may not be available.

Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to my personal data being transferred abroad to the recipients and for the purposes above, in incidental cases where the safeguards of KVKK art. 9 are not in place.”

sections.heading: Consent 7 — Face photo and “See it on me”
paragraphs: Purpose: when you have no full-body photo, to build your figure from your face photo together with the body type, height and size you choose, and to generate images that show outfits on that figure (“See it on me”).

Data: the face photo you upload, the body type you choose, your height and size, and the images generated from them. Your weight is not used. No identification, verification or face recognition takes place; no face template that uniquely identifies you is extracted or stored.
Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) to generate the images.
How long: until you delete the face photo or the generated images, or your account. The photo and the images are never shown to other users in any setting.
If you do not consent: you cannot use “See it on me” without a full-body photo; you can still use it by adding one. The colour palette analysis does not depend on this consent.

Consent statement: “I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my face photo, together with my body type, height and size and without identifying me, to generate ‘See it on me’ images, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).” [LEGAL REVIEW: new purpose — building a figure from the face photo]

sections.heading: Withdrawing your consent
paragraphs: You can withdraw any consent at any time:

- Full-body and face photo: delete the photo under Profile › Privacy; the related consents count as withdrawn (for the face photo: the colour palette and the face-photo “See it on me” consents) and the generated images or the palette result are deleted. You can also switch each consent off under Profile › Privacy › My consents.
- Weight: clear the weight field in your body profile in the app.
- Contacts: switch off Droblet's contacts permission in your phone's settings.
- Marketing notifications: switch off the notification under Profile › Settings › Notifications.
- In any other case, or in addition to the above: write to info@alatech.co.
Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing before the withdrawal. [LEGAL REVIEW: consent withdrawal screen in the app]

subscriptionTerms.title: Subscription Terms
subscriptionTerms.description: Droblet Membership and extra AI image packs: what is included, price, free trial, auto-renewal, cancellation, refunds and the right to cancel.
subscriptionTerms.intro: These terms govern the Droblet Membership subscription and extra AI image packs and form part of the Terms of Use. Purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play; payment, billing and refunds are also subject to the terms of the store you use.
summary: Droblet Membership is monthly or yearly; the current price and any free trial are shown in the store before you buy.
Membership includes 30 AI images every month. Unused images do not roll over to the next month.
Membership renews automatically and your store account is charged unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
You cancel in the App Store or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting the app or your account does not cancel the subscription.
Refund requests go to Apple or Google; Droblet does not take the payment and so cannot refund directly.
When your membership ends your data is not deleted; only the membership features are switched off.

sections.heading: What Droblet Membership includes
paragraphs: - 30 AI images (“See it on me”) in every subscription month;
- a personal stylist: daily outfit suggestions and a weekly plan;
- a smart suitcase: packing lists and daily looks for your trips;
- colour palette analysis from your face photo;
- unlimited AI item recognition.
Text-based AI features such as the stylist, packing and the palette do not use AI image credits.

sections.heading: What is free without membership
paragraphs: Wardrobe (including adding items by hand), looks, calendar, shop, cart, watch list and friends are free without membership. Non-members can use AI item recognition for free on their first 10 item photos; after that they can always keep adding items by hand.
When a non-member taps an AI feature, the membership screen is shown.

sections.heading: Plans and prices
paragraphs: Droblet Membership comes in two plans: monthly and yearly. Prices are shown in Turkish lira, including taxes, in the App Store or Google Play before you buy; the price shown in the app is read from the store.
The store calculates the price with the currency and taxes it applies. Price and currency may differ depending on your country.

sections.heading: Free trial
paragraphs: New subscribers may be offered a free trial through the store. The trial length and the amount charged when it ends are shown on the store's purchase screen before you confirm.

Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the trial turns into a paid subscription and the price of the plan you chose is charged. If you cancel during the trial you keep the membership features until the trial ends.
Under the store's eligibility rules, the free trial can be used once per Apple ID or Google account. If you buy a paid plan during the trial, the rest of the trial is forfeited.

sections.heading: Payment and auto-renewal
paragraphs: Payment is charged to the payment method of your Apple ID or Google account when you confirm the purchase.

The subscription renews automatically for the same period at the then-current price unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends.

If a renewal payment fails, the store retries for a while; during that time (grace period) your access to membership features may continue as the store reports. If payment cannot be collected, the membership ends.

sections.heading: Cancellation
paragraphs: You can cancel your subscription at any time:
- iPhone: Settings › your name › Subscriptions › Droblet Membership › Cancel Subscription;
- Android: Google Play › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions › Droblet Membership › Cancel subscription.
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; you keep membership features until then. No refund is given for a partly used period, except under the store's rules.
Deleting the app or your Droblet account does not cancel the subscription. Cancel in the store before you delete your account.

sections.heading: AI image allowance
paragraphs: Membership includes 30 AI images in every subscription month. One “See it on me” image uses 1 credit. The allowance is topped up to 30 at the start of each subscription month; unused images do not roll over. On the yearly plan the allowance also renews monthly.

Before a task that will create several images (for example every day of the weekly plan), the app shows how many credits it will use and asks you to confirm. If the image of the same outfit is requested again, it comes from the cache and no second credit is used. If an image cannot be created, the credit is returned.
You can see your remaining credits on the Profile screen.

sections.heading: Extra AI image packs
paragraphs: When your monthly allowance runs out you can buy an extra AI image pack (for example 20 images) in the app. Packs are consumable in-app purchases and can be bought again; the price is shown in the store before you buy.

Pack credits are used after your monthly allowance and are not removed at the end of the month. Because pack credits are used for “See it on me”, they can be spent only while your membership is active; if your membership ends, your remaining pack credits are kept and can be used when you subscribe again. [LEGAL REVIEW: pack credits tied to membership, and their duration]
If the store refunds a pack, the credits left from that pack are removed from your balance (the balance never goes below zero); images created before the refund are not deleted.

sections.heading: Changing plan and restoring purchases
paragraphs: You can switch between the monthly and yearly plan in the store's subscription settings. The store decides when the switch takes effect and any price difference (usually an upgrade applies at once and a downgrade at the end of the period). Your AI image month is kept when you switch.
On a new device or after reinstalling, “Restore purchases” on the membership screen links your subscription to your account again.
A purchase can be linked to one Droblet account only. A purchase linked to another Droblet account cannot be restored; if that account was deleted, the purchase can be linked to the new account.

sections.heading: Refunds
paragraphs: Apple or Google, not Droblet, takes the payment; so please send refund requests to the store directly:
- App Store: reportaproblem.apple.com or Apple Support;
- Google Play: your order history in Google Play or the Google Play refund request page.
The store decides on refunds under its refund policy. When a subscription is refunded, membership access ends on the refund date.
This section does not limit your right to cancel below or any other rights you have under consumer law.

sections.heading: Right to cancel (withdrawal)
paragraphs: For consumers in Türkiye: under art. 15/1-ğ of the Distance Contracts Regulation, there is no right of withdrawal for services performed instantly in electronic form or intangible goods delivered instantly to the consumer. By confirming at purchase that the membership features are made available immediately, you accept that you lose the right of withdrawal for this reason. You can cancel free of charge at any time during a free trial. [LEGAL REVIEW: applicability to subscriptions and extra packs]

For consumers in the United Kingdom: under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 you have a 14-day right to cancel for digital content and services. If you expressly ask for digital content (for example an extra AI image pack) to be supplied immediately within the cancellation period and acknowledge that you lose your right to cancel, the right ends once the content is supplied. For the subscription service, if you ask for the service to start within the cancellation period and then cancel, you may have to pay for the service provided up to that point in proportion. [LEGAL REVIEW: subscription rules of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024]
You can give notice of cancellation through the store's refund channel or at info@alatech.co; if you contact us, we will help you through the store's refund process.

sections.heading: Price and scope changes
paragraphs: We may change the subscription price. We announce price increases before they take effect in the app and, as the store's rules require, through the store; where the store requires it, it asks you to accept the increase. If you do not accept, the subscription ends at the end of the current period.

If we change the monthly number of AI images or the scope of membership to your disadvantage, we will tell you in advance; the change applies from the next renewal period and you can cancel before then.

sections.heading: When your membership ends
paragraphs: When your membership ends none of your data is deleted. Your wardrobe, looks, calendar, trips, your existing colour palette result and the images already created stay available; only new AI tasks (new images, new suggestions, new analyses) are switched off. Unused monthly AI images expire.
Your rights to delete your photos, delete your account, change your closet visibility and restore purchases are never restricted on any plan.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about membership, credits or purchases: info@alatech.co. For payments and refunds, please use the store's support channels.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.description: Use of cookies and similar technologies on the droblet.alatech.co website and in the Droblet app.
cookies.intro: This notice explains the use of cookies and similar technologies (browser storage, device storage, tracking pixels) on the droblet.alatech.co website and in the Droblet mobile app.
summary: Our website's own code sets no cookies and saves no data in your browser.
We use no analytics, advertising, social media or tracking tools, so we do not ask for cookie consent.
Fonts are served from our own server; opening a page sends no request to Google or any other third party.
Cloudflare, which delivers and protects the site, may use a strictly necessary security cookie.
If we ever add a cookie that is not strictly necessary, we will ask for your consent first.

sections.heading: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files saved in your browser when you visit a website. Similar technologies include the browser's local storage (localStorage, sessionStorage), apps storing data on the device and tracking pixels embedded in pages. In this notice “cookies” covers all of them.

sections.heading: What our website uses
paragraphs: droblet.alatech.co is a static website. The site's own code:
- does not set or read cookies;
- does not save data in localStorage, sessionStorage or IndexedDB;
- contains no analytics, advertising, retargeting, social media plug-ins or tracking pixels;
- serves fonts and images from its own domain; opening a page sends no request to Google Fonts or any other third party.

The “Delete my account” and “Reset password” pages send what you enter to the Droblet API only to carry out that action. During account deletion the session token is kept only in the page's memory; it is never stored in a cookie or browser storage and is gone when you close the page.
On the link pages (invite, look, password reset) your browser's language setting is read only to send you to the right language page; it is not saved anywhere.

sections.heading: Cloudflare
paragraphs: Our website is delivered through Cloudflare. To keep the site fast and secure, Cloudflare processes visitors' IP addresses and request details and may set a strictly necessary security cookie to tell malicious traffic (bots) apart.

Such cookies are strictly necessary for the site to run securely and, under the Turkish KVKK Cookie Guidelines and regulation 6 of the UK PECR, need no consent. Cloudflare does not use this information for advertising. [LEGAL REVIEW: confirm Cloudflare settings]

sections.heading: Mobile app
paragraphs: The Droblet app uses no cookies and contains no advertising or tracking SDKs; it does not read the advertising identifier (IDFA/AAID) and does not track you across apps. For product analytics it uses the Google Analytics for Firebase SDK, which keeps an app instance id and the events waiting to be sent on your device. You can switch it off under Settings › Privacy › “Product analytics” (Privacy Policy section 9). [LEGAL REVIEW: PECR reg. 6 — the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 exception for storage used for analytics, with the opportunity to object]

The app keeps on your device only what it needs to work: session tokens in the device's secure storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore), your language preference and a short-lived image cache in the app's own space. The relevant cache is cleared when you sign out and when you delete your photos.
The usage events the app sends to our own servers are described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: External links
paragraphs: When you go from our website or the app to the App Store, Google Play or a brand's shop, those sites may use their own cookies. When you visit a brand in the in-app browser, cookies that the brand and the affiliate network (for example Admitad or Gelir Ortakları / ReklamAction) use to match the order to the click are their responsibility and follow their cookie policies.

sections.heading: Managing your preferences
paragraphs: You can see, delete and block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking Cloudflare's security cookie may make the site show a verification screen in some cases.
To clear the cache in the app, sign out or uninstall the app.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If we add analytics or any other cookie that is not strictly necessary, we will update this notice and ask for your explicit consent before the cookie is placed; you can use the site without consenting.
Questions: info@alatech.co.

communityGuidelines.title: Community Guidelines
communityGuidelines.description: Community guidelines for items, looks, profiles and ratings on Droblet; reporting, blocking and moderation.
communityGuidelines.intro: On Droblet you can browse your friends' closets, rate their looks and take inspiration from them. These guidelines exist so that everyone feels safe and comfortable in the community. They form part of the Terms of Use.
summary: Share only your own clothes and your own looks; never upload other people's photos.
Nudity, sexual content, hate, harassment, violence and misleading accounts are not allowed.
Rate the look, not the person. Ratings are anonymous; don't misuse that.
You can report and block a person or their content from the ⋯ menu on their profile.
We review reports; we remove content that breaks the rules and may suspend accounts.

sections.heading: What the community shares
paragraphs: On Droblet other users can see (depending on your closet visibility setting):
- your profile card: username, display name, style tags, follower counts;
- your wardrobe items: the background-removed item image and the item's name;
- your looks and their average rating.
Your full-body and face photos, the images generated on you and your colour palette are never shared. Droblet has no comments or private messages.

sections.heading: What you can share
paragraphs: - Photos of clothes, shoes, bags and accessories you own or wear.
- Looks you create and the names you give them.
- A username and display name that reflect you and do not impersonate anyone else.

When you photograph an item, make sure no other people, documents or personal information are visible in the background. The app removes the background of item images; others see only this cleaned image.

sections.heading: What you must not share
paragraphs: - Nudity, sexual content, or sexualised use of underwear or swimwear photos;
- photos of anyone under 18, or any content relating to the sexual abuse of children (we report such content to the authorities);
- a photo of another person taken or uploaded without their consent;
- content that demeans, hates or discriminates on the basis of race, ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, body or appearance — including usernames and look names;
- threats, harassment, bullying or content glorifying violence;
- accounts that impersonate another person, influencer or brand;
- spam, advertising, referral links, or names containing personal contact details (phone, address, e-mail);
- counterfeit, smuggled or illegal products, weapons or drugs;
- images protected by someone else's copyright (for example uploading a brand's campaign photo as if it were your own item). To add shop products to your look, use the shop option in the app.

sections.heading: Rating
paragraphs: You can rate looks from 1 to 5 stars. Ratings are anonymous: the look's owner sees only the average and how many people rated it, never who gave what.

A rating is an opinion on a look's style, not a judgement of a person's body or appearance. Mass or coordinated low ratings to target someone, rating from fake accounts and trading ratings are not allowed.

sections.heading: Respect and privacy
paragraphs: If an account is Private or Followers only, you cannot see the closet until your follow request is approved; don't keep repeating a declined request.
Do not use images from other people's closets or looks to humiliate or expose them, or for commercial purposes without permission.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: If you see a profile, item or look that breaks the rules, tap ⋯ › Report on the person's profile. Choose a reason: spam, inappropriate content, harassment, impersonation, minor safety or other. You can add a note of up to 500 characters.
The person you report is never told who you are. To prevent abuse, an account can send at most 20 reports a day; knowingly filing false reports also breaks these guidelines.
Our moderation team reviews reports. Reports about the safety of minors are prioritised.
If you cannot access the app or want to report something from outside it, write to info@alatech.co.

sections.heading: Blocking
paragraphs: You can block someone from their profile with ⋯ › Block. When you block someone:
- you cannot see each other in search, on profiles, in the feed, in suggestions or in contact matching;
- follow relationships and pending follow requests between you are removed in both directions;
- you cannot rate, report or follow each other.
The blocked person is not notified. You can see the people you blocked and unblock them under Profile › Settings; unblocking does not restore follow relationships.

sections.heading: Moderation and enforcement
paragraphs: A moderator reviews every report and decides on one of these outcomes:
- close the report (if no rule was broken);
- remove the content;
- warn the account owner;
- suspend the account — a suspended account cannot sign in.

For serious violations (for example child abuse or serious threats) we may close the account without warning and, where required, report it to the competent authorities. Moderators cannot see users' full-body or face photos or generated images; reviews are based only on content visible to others.
Repeated violations lead to stronger measures.

sections.heading: Appeals
paragraphs: If you think your content was removed or your account suspended by mistake, write to info@alatech.co with your username within 30 days of learning of the decision. Your appeal is reviewed by someone who did not make the first decision, and we tell you the outcome. [LEGAL REVIEW: appeal period]

sections.heading: Emergencies
paragraphs: If you think someone's life or safety is in danger, call the emergency services first: 112 in Türkiye, 999 in the United Kingdom. Droblet is not an emergency service.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these guidelines as the community grows. We announce material changes in the app.

sections.title: What data is processed?

- Wardrobe: photos and descriptions of clothes, outfits, plans and wear log, trips.

sections.title: What can your child do?

sections.title: What can your child not do?
